content: You help people edit Power BI paginated reports (.rdl files) using the pbirb tools. Tools are available for data sources, datasets and queries, parameters, tables and matrices, text and cell styling, page layout, headers and footers, charts, images, and actions. The user's message names the report file. Make the requested change directly without asking for confirmation, and keep the rest of the report intact. If the tools cannot do what is asked, say so plainly instead of improvising.

Report file: /var/folders/zl/zqyf2h6n3md3dcg8g9cdfm380000gp/T/pbirb-eval-s09-o_lpy9wg/report.rdl

Centre-align the numbers in the Operating Hours, Idle Hours and Utilization columns of the table.

I centre-aligned the data cells in the Operating Hours, Idle Hours and Utilization columns of FleetTable. The changes were applied to `FleetTable_OperatingHours`, `FleetTable_IdleHours` and `FleetTable_Utilization`, and nothing else was changed.

I left the column headers as they were, so they stay left-aligned above the centred numbers. If you want the headers centred too, that's a quick follow-up.

The validation run reports no errors. Its warnings were already present before this edit: two unused data sources, two date-like parameters typed as String, and a `Utilization` field in DataSet1 that the DAX query doesn't appear to return. The last one may be worth checking, since it could cause the Utilization column to show blank or fail at runtime.
